NONE: › to be something that someone will experience or have to deal with soon

example: Upon her head she wore a black velvet hat.
她頭戴一頂黑色天鵝絨帽子。
You can never place enough emphasis upon the importance of safety.
無論怎樣強調安全的重要性都不過分。
Upon your arrival (= as soon as you arrive), please report to the reception desk.
到達後請即刻到接待處報到。
Another few weeks and spring will be upon us.
再過幾個星期，春天就要來了。

NONE: 喲，嗨，哎呀（表示驚訝或生氣）

example: My word! Is that Jenkins on the roof?
哎呀！屋頂上不是詹金斯嗎？
